title: Something blew up at the airport last night.
content: Or maybe it was bombed, I'm not sure. I heard a loud explosion from the building I was in, which is not exactly the mall but is a place I am in often. Sort of a room in the back of a house I guess. I ran outside and saw off in the distance a big explosion and something else coming out of the sky going toward it. Maybe a missile. I went back out later and saw a big military helicopter flying overhead with a line hanging out of it. I remembered thinking it was odd that they were flying with the rope extended. There was also a smaller aircraft flying by it. I don't remember if it was a helicopter or an airplane. Anyone else experience anything like this?
